title_en: Military Information: Peace Preservation Corps Officers Schools in North Korea
subject_ko: 북조선 전역에서 17세부터 25세까지 청년을 징집해 보안대 장교학교에 넣고 있다는 보고다. 총사령부와 지휘부, 평양 중앙학교와 신의주 학교의 편제, 무장, 교육 내용을 항목별로 적었다.
key_points_ko: 17세부터 25세까지 청년이 북조선 전역에서 징집되어 보안대 장교학교로 간다. 신의주 일대는 구역마다 500명을 뽑는다. 징병은 북조선 군사위원회 군사부가 맡는다.
총사령부는 나남(129-41, 41-42)에 있고 총사령관은 CHOE Yong-kon 최용건, 부사령관은 MU Chong 무정이다. 무정은 옌안의 조선의용군 사령관이자 조선독립동맹 책임자였다.
학교들은 1946년 3월에 정치학교라는 이름으로 세워졌다가 보안대 장교학교로 이름이 바뀌었다. 소련군 검열단이 한 주에 한 번 각 학교를 검열한다.
모든 학교에 「사상 검열」 부서가 있다. 검열관 두세 명이 학생들과 함께 훈련받으며 반동 사상을 가진 학생을 찾아낸다.
졸업생과 재학생을 합해 약 130,0[판독 불가]0명이라고 적었다. 졸업생은 대개 38선 부근에 배치된다.
평양의 중앙 보안대 장교학교만이 진짜 장교를 임관시킨다. 현재 학생 600명이다. 다른 학교 졸업생은 임관되지 않는다.
평양 지구사령부가 신리에 세워졌고 부사령관은 PAK Hyo-sam 박효삼이다. 제3연대 본부는 신의주 남서쪽에 있고 연대장은 CHANG Tok-sam 장덕삼이다. 대대장 셋은 모두 옌안에서 돌아온 자들이다.
남신의주 주둔 부대는 일본식 1-33형 소총과 소련식 기관총 20정, 박격포 3문으로 무장했다.
신의주 학교는 훈련 기간 6개월이고 낮에는 소련군 장교가 지도한다. 러시아어도 가르친다. 학교 책임자는 신의주 소련군 특무기관 사령관이다.
신의주 학교 제1기는 지원자 남자 600명과 여자 100명이었고 제2기는 추천, 제3기는 징집이다. 현재 기수는 3000명이다.

1. Young men between the ages of 17 and 25 are being conscripted throughout North Korea and sent to the Peace Preservation Corps Officers Schools.

2. Each district (?) in the Sinuiju (Shingishu) (124-2[판독 불가], 40-06) area selects 500 persons between the ages of 17 and 25 to undergo training in Peace Preservation Corps Officers Schools.

3. The Military Affairs Department of the North Korea Military Committee is in charge of military conscription for all the Peace Preservation Corps Officers Schools in North Korea.

8. A "thought inspection" department is maintained in all Peace Preservation Corps Officers Schools. Two or three "inspectors" undergo training with each class of students to discover those students who have reactionary ideas.
25X1

9. [판독 불가] schools now known as Peace Preservation Corps Officers Schools were originally established in March 1946 and were first known as Political Schools. These Political Schools had been established to indoctrinate the young Koreans with Communistic ideas and to give them military training.
25X1

10. The important members of the staffs of the Peace Preservation Corps Officers Schools are mainly Koreans who received training in the Soviet Political Schools in the USSR or in the Eighth Route Army Military and Political School at Yenan. These instructors are intelligent and possess considerable ability. The other members of the staff are from the local areas. Their ability is considerably less than that of the important members of the staffs.
25X1A   25X1

[번호 없음] The total number of graduates of the Peace Preservation Officers Schools and the students receiving training in the schools is approximately 130,0[판독 불가]0.

[번호 없음] Graduates of the Peace Preservation Corps Officers Schools have usually been assigned duty in the southern part of North Korea in the vicinity of the 38th parallel. Some have been assigned as instructors in Peace Preservation Corps Units. Some of the exceptional students have been sent for [판독 불가] to the Central Peace Preservation Officers School in Pyongyang. [판독 불가] the only school in North Korea engaged in training Korean soldiers to [판독 불가] officers in the Peace Preservation Corps Units.

Central Peace Preservation (Corps?) Officers School in Pyongyang

13. The Central Peace Preservation Officers School in Pyongyang is the only real officers training school in North Korea. Graduates of this school are commissioned as officers in the Peace Preservation Corps. Graduates of the other Peace Preservation Corps Officers Schools are neither commissioned as officers nor do they receive the grade of any commissioned officer.
25X1

14. Candidates for the Central Peace Preservation Officers School in Pyongyang are usually selected from the outstanding students at the other so-called Peace Preservation Corps Officers Schools. Sometimes Peace Preservation Corps Unit members who have demonstrated special ability and have passed a special entrance examination are also selected as candidates for this school.
25X1

15. Graduates of the Central Peace Preservation Officers School in Pyongyang are assigned as officers in Peace Preservation Corps Units.

16. There are now 600 students enrolled in the Central Peace Preservation Officers School in Pyongyang.

17. Only members of the Korean Volunteer Army and graduates of the Pyongyang Central Peace Preservation Officers School are qualified to become members of the staffs of Peace Preservation Corps Units.

PYONGYANG DISTRICT HEADQUARTERS OF THE PEACE PRESERVATION CORPS OFFICERS SCHOOLS

18. A Pyongyang District Headquarters of the Peace Preservation Corps Officers Schools was recently established in the Sinri (Shin Ri) suburb of Pyongyang ([한자 판독 불가]) (125-[판독 불가]4, 39-01). The District Commander is LU Chong [원문 그대로]. (Note: See paragraph 7). The Vice Commander is PAK Hyo-sam ([한자 판독 불가]). [판독 불가] is a graduate of the Military and Political School ([한자 판독 불가]) in Yenan and was the head of the Military Department of the Korean Independence League in Yenan.

19. The Headquarters of the 3rd Regiment of the Pyongyang District Headquarters of the Peace Preservation Corps Officers Schools is at [판독 불가]akwon ([한자 판독 불가]), a few kilometers southwest of Sinuiju. Note: [판독 불가] There is a [판독 불가]akwon District in South Sinuiju. Also previously reported by another American agency: The 3rd Training Unit of the Third Military District of the Peace Preservation Corps Officers Schools, with headquarters at Pyongyang, is at Pongnyousedong /? 125-16, 39-00 or 125-30, 10-12 ?/; the 3rd Training Unit of the First Military District of the Peace Preservation Corps Officers Schools, with headquarters at Kaechon /Kuisen/ /125-58, 39-[판독 불가]0/ is at South Sinuiju, a few kilometers from Sinuiju proper.)

20. Commanding Officer of the 3rd Regimental Headquarters is CHANG Tok-sam ([한자 판독 불가]). He was the Commanding Officer of the 2nd group of the Korean Volunteer Army in Yenan.

21. The 3rd Regiment consists of three battalions. The Commanding Officer of the 1st Battalion of the 3rd Regiment is O [판독 불가] ([한자 판독 불가]), who is a graduate of the Military and Political School in Yenan and was a member of the Korean Independence League in Yenan. The Commanding Officer of the 2nd Battalion is [판독 불가] U-mon ([한자 판독 불가]). The Commanding Officer of the 3rd Battalion is Y[판독 불가] Jang-kuk ([한자 판독 불가]). O, [판독 불가] and YE returned to Korea from Yenan after V-J Day.

22. Some of the units of the 3rd Regiment are stationed in the former commercial middle school in South Sinuiju.

23. Units of the 3rd Regiment stationed in South Sinuiju are armed with rifles of the Japanese 1-33 type [원문 그대로]. They also have 20 machine guns of the Soviet type and three trench mortars.

25X1   Sinuiju Peace Preservation Corps Officers School

24. The Peace Preservation Corps Officers School in Sinuiju is divided into [판독 불가] sections. One section (? units of the 3rd Regiment mentioned in paragraph 22 ?) is located in the former commercial middle school in South Sinuiju. The other section of the school is in the wharf area of Sinuiju proper.
25X1

25. The length of the training course in the Sinuiju Peace Preservation Corps Officers School is six months. Infantry and artillery training is given. The school has three artillery pieces which are used in the training course. Military training is received during the daytime under the guidance of Soviet officers. Additional instruction, both military and political, is given by the Korean instructors attached to the school. Instruction in the Russian language is also given.
25X1   25X1

26. The head of the school is the Commanding Officer of the Special Service Headquarters of the Soviet Army in Sinuiju. [삭제] Note: Previously reported:

Lt. Col. Pimashiht'ou /Chinese phoneticization/ is Commanding Officer of the Soviet Special Service /counter-espionage/ Headquarters in Sinuiju.

27. The Peace Preservation Corps Officers School in Sinuiju was first known as the Political School. Two classes were graduated from this school and the third is now in training. Approximately 600 men and 100 women were trained in the first class when the school was still known as the Political School. Students of the first class were all volunteers. Students of the second class were persons with some formal education and had been recommended for the training by the Peace Preservation Corps Units and the political parties. Students of the third class were conscripted for the training. Most of the students in the third class, the present class, are from the villages in the Sinuiju area.

28. There are 3000 students in the present class in the Peace Preservation Corps Officers School in Sinuiju.

29. Most of the graduates of the Sinuiju School have been sent to the area around the 38th parallel for duty.

1. 17세부터 25세까지의 청년들이 북조선 전역에서 징집되어 보안대 장교학교(Peace Preservation Corps Officers Schools)로 보내지고 있다.

2. 신의주(Sinuiju 新義州, 일본식 Shingishu) (124-2[판독 불가], 40-06) 일대의 각 구역(?)은 17세부터 25세까지 500명을 뽑아 보안대 장교학교에서 훈련을 받게 한다.

3. 북조선 군사위원회(North Korea Military Committee)의 군사부(Military Affairs Department)가 북조선의 모든 보안대 장교학교에 대한 징병을 맡고 있다.

8. 모든 보안대 장교학교에는 「사상 검열(thought inspection)」 부서가 두어져 있다. 검열관(inspectors) 두세 명이 학생 각 기수와 함께 훈련을 받으면서 반동 사상을 가진 학생을 찾아낸다.
25X1

9. [판독 불가] 지금 보안대 장교학교로 불리는 학교들은 원래 1946년 3월에 세워졌고 처음에는 정치학교(Political Schools)로 불렸다. 이 정치학교들은 조선 청년들에게 공산주의 사상을 주입하고 군사훈련을 시키기 위해 세워진 것이었다.
25X1

10. 보안대 장교학교 교직원 가운데 중요한 자들은 주로 소련 내의 소련 정치학교(Soviet Political Schools)나 옌안의 팔로군 군정학교(Eighth Route Army Military and Political School)에서 훈련을 받은 조선인이다. 이 교관들은 영리하고 상당한 능력을 갖추고 있다. 나머지 교직원은 그 지역 출신이다. 이들의 능력은 중요한 교직원들보다 상당히 떨어진다.

[번호 없음] 보안대 장교학교의 졸업생과 재학 중인 학생을 합한 총수는 약 130,0[판독 불가]0명이다.

[번호 없음] 보안대 장교학교 졸업생은 대개 북조선 남부, 38선 부근에 배치되어 왔다. 일부는 보안대 부대의 교관으로 배치되었다. 뛰어난 학생 일부는 평양의 중앙 보안대 장교학교(Central Peace Preservation Officers School)로 [판독 불가] 보내졌다. [판독 불가] 북조선에서 조선인 병사를 보안대 부대의 장교로 만들기 위해 훈련하는 유일한 학교다.

평양의 중앙 보안대(?) 장교학교(Central Peace Preservation (Corps?) Officers School in Pyongyang)

13. 평양의 중앙 보안대 장교학교는 북조선에서 유일한 진짜 장교 양성 학교다. 이 학교 졸업생은 보안대 장교로 임관된다. 다른 보안대 장교학교의 졸업생은 장교로 임관되지도 않고 어떤 임관 장교의 계급도 받지 않는다.

17. 조선의용군 출신과 평양 중앙 보안대 장교학교 졸업생만이 보안대 부대의 참모진이 될 자격이 있다.
